nom: STARFACE Hydro-Star Extra Small Pimple Patches

segments.sensitive: One reviewer notes the patches are gentle and safe for sensitive skin, causing no irritation around the nose or lip area.

concerns.spots: Reviewers consistently describe the tiny stars as well suited to small, isolated blemishes, whiteheads, and bumps near the nose, lip, or neck, with several reporting pimples flattened or less visible by the next day; one warns that patches may need changing more often when a blemish holds a lot of fluid.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with scarring or recurring small blemishes report the patches help flatten spots quickly and stop them from picking at their skin, describing fast, noticeable improvement; no negative outcomes on blemishes are reported.

aspects.libelle: Black patch mistaken for marker or food
Limited absorption for very fluid blemishes

reserve: Reviews focus overwhelmingly on size, cuteness, and packaging rather than detailed skin type or concern breakdowns, so segment and concern coverage beyond spots and blemishes is thin.
